_about: Published maritime-militia identifications for the Maritime tab's civilian-fleet layer (Phase 2g).
Every row is a citation, never this site's inference: Appendix A = vessels the study identified as militia
from primary indicators (confidence 'identified'); Appendix B = vessels meeting supporting indicators
(confidence 'likely'). Rows are keyed on the MMSI as printed in 2021 — hulls re-register, so a match is
'this MMSI was listed', not 'this hull is militia today'. Fleet is South-China-Sea-focused (Hainan,
Guangdong, Guangxi ports); absence from the list means nothing about a hull.
Owner strings are as extracted from the PDF text layer (footnote numbers stripped) and may carry
wrapped-cell artefacts; name_zh is reconstructed from the pinyin family + hull number.
Add rows by hand with the same keys; scraper/scrapers/gfw_civil.py reads `vessels[].mmsi`.
